title: Fair List Lookup Permission Consistency

items.action: list fair metadata for lookup controls

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: Existing fair read permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing backend fair read authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; the frontend API client now fails closed before unauthorized list requests.

tenant_isolation.reason: Existing organization-scoped fair authorization remains unchanged.

audit.reason: Read-only lookup behavior introduces no new auditable mutation.

route_guard.reason: This hardens reusable fair lookup behavior rather than route access.

notes: getFair already rejected locally when fair_crm.fairs.read was absent, while listFairs still issued the request. listFairs now applies the same fail-closed client boundary, preventing unauthorized optional lookup traffic from FairEntitySelect and other consumers.
